company.description: Multipool is a cutting-edge DEX transforming the trading landscape for RWAs and cryptocurrencies. It is designed for fairness and equality, featuring a fully decentralized on-chain order book, deep liquidity through dynamic bracket pools, and utilizing on-chain compliance tools.

productsAndServices.description: An on-chain order book system that manages over 1 billion orders and cancellations per tick price, enhanced by dynamic bracket pools to improve market liquidity.
productsAndServices.name: Fully Trustless On-Chain Order Book

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized marketplace enabling fully on-chain trading of real-world assets (RWAs) alongside cryptocurrencies.
productsAndServices.name: Global Real World Asset Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized peer-to-peer lending service facilitating direct lending transactions without intermediaries.
productsAndServices.name: P2P Repo Lending

productsAndServices.description: An auction mechanism designed to execute trades without causing price impact, ensuring optimal trade execution.
productsAndServices.name: Zero Price Impact Auctions

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized protocol enabling transparent and secure quote requests for trades without intermediaries.

productsAndServices.description: A feature that protects trades from front-running and other malicious Miner Extractable Value (MEV) activities.
